script.code:
SELECT CASE WHEN o.operation_status = 'REQUIRES_REVIEW' THEN 'OPEN_REVIEW'
            WHEN o.operation_status IN ('MUTATING', 'VERIFYING') THEN 'STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED'
            ELSE 'STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION' END AS kind,
       o.organization_id AS organization_id, o.plant_id AS plant_id, o.operation_id AS operation_id, o.operation_status AS operation_status, o.result_code AS result_code,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (g.id IS NOT NULL) AS gate_taken, g.owner_operation_id AS gate_owner
  FROM inventory_operation o
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.organization_id = o.organization_id
   AND g.lock_key = CONCAT('GATE|', o.operation_id)
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
   AND ((o.operation_status IN ('RECEIVED', 'VALIDATING', 'LOCKING', 'LOCKED', 'MUTATING', 'VERIFYING') AND o.lease_expires_at < NOW(3))
        OR (o.operation_status = 'REQUIRES_REVIEW' AND COALESCE(o.result_code, '') <> 'REVIEW_CLOSED'))
 ORDER BY o.id
 LIMIT 200

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS db_now_f,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       o.operation_id,
       o.plant_id,
       o.operation_status,
       o.result_code,
       o.review_reference,
       o.review_reason,
       o.original_operation_id,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.mutation_started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS mutation_started_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS lease_expires_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completed_at,
       o.row_version,
       o.lock_count,
       o.is_deleted,
       (COALESCE(o.completed_at, o.update_time) < n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS owner_past_grace,
       (o.lease_expires_at < n.t - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE) AS lease_quiet,
       (g.id IS NOT NULL) AS gate_taken,
       g.owner_operation_id AS gate_owner,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blade_user u
         WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}' AND u.is_deleted = 0
           AND u.id = {{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.approvedBy}}) AS approver_ok
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN inventory_operation o
    ON o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.organizationId}}'
   AND o.operation_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.operationId}}'
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.organizationId}}'
   AND g.lock_key = CONCAT('GATE|', '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.operationId}}')

script.code:
SELECT r.lock_key AS lock_key, o2.operation_id AS operation_id, o2.operation_status AS operation_status, o2.result_code AS result_code,
       DATE_FORMAT(o2.mutation_started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS mutation_started_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(o2.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS lease_expires_at,
       (g2.id IS NOT NULL) AS gate_taken, g2.owner_operation_id AS gate_owner
  FROM inventory_balance_lock r
  JOIN inventory_operation_effect e
    ON e.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND e.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.organizationId}}'
   AND (e.balance_key = r.lock_key
        OR (e.balance_type = 'BATCH' AND r.lock_key = CONCAT('ITEM|', e.material_id, '|', e.location_id)))
   AND e.is_deleted = 0
  JOIN inventory_operation o2
    ON o2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o2.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.organizationId}}'
   AND o2.operation_id = e.operation_id
   AND o2.is_deleted = 0
   AND o2.operation_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'REJECTED')
   AND COALESCE(o2.result_code, '') <> 'REVIEW_CLOSED'
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock g2
    ON g2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g2.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.organizationId}}'
   AND g2.lock_key = CONCAT('GATE|', o2.operation_id)
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.tenantId}}'
   AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.organizationId}}'
   AND r.balance_type IN ('ITEM', 'BATCH', 'HU', 'RESERVATION')
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
   AND r.last_owner_operation_id = '{{node:code_node_hIvKJCHM.data.operationId}}'
   AND r.free_token = 0
   AND (r.owner_operation_id IS NULL OR r.owner_operation_id = '')
 GROUP BY r.lock_key, o2.operation_id, o2.operation_status, o2.result_code, o2.mutation_started_at, o2.lease_expires_at, g2.id, g2.owner_operation_id
